The software is provided \"as is\", without any express or implied warranty.

2. Description
This app independently configures the display density (DPI) and resolution for individual applications at the system level. The configuration takes effect through the injection mechanism of the Xposed / EdXposed / LSPosed framework. It only affects the target application you select, does not change the overall system display, and does not modify the global system density.

3. Conditions of Use
1. You must enable this module in the Xposed / EdXposed / LSPosed framework and restart your device for it to take effect.
2. Some functions (such as adjusting configuration file permissions, terminating the target app process, and obtaining the full app list through the root interface) require root access.
3. Do not use this app for any purpose that violates laws or regulations or infringes on the rights of others. All consequences arising from the use of this app are borne by the user.

4. Privacy Commitment
This app requests no internet permission. It does not collect, upload, or share your personal information. All configurations are stored only in the SharedPreferences on your local device and are cleared when the app is uninstalled.

5. Feedback and Support
If you encounter any problems, you can contact the developer through the contact information on the About page.

License: MIT License
Updated: Nov 9, 2026

This is a system-level display adjustment tool for advanced users, running on top of the Xposed / EdXposed / LSPosed framework. It lets you set a separate display density (DPI) and resolution for any app on your device without changing the global system parameters.

Unlike the built-in display scaling, the configuration in this app applies per app independently: you can keep one app at high density and another at low density, without interference. The configuration takes effect when the target app starts, through a system injection mechanism, and remains transparent to the system itself.

Please read the following three tabs to understand the required permissions, security notes, and the complete usage flow.
This app must be enabled in the Xposed / EdXposed / LSPosed framework and granted root access to take effect. Please make sure the runtime environment meets these requirements.

The following prerequisites are required to run this app:

1. Xposed / EdXposed / LSPosed framework: it must be installed, and this module must be enabled in the framework. After enabling the module, restart the device for it to take effect.
2. Root access: used to make this app's configuration file (SharedPreferences) globally readable so the injection module can read the configuration in the target app process, and to terminate the target app process after saving the configuration so the settings take effect immediately.
3. Query installed apps: used to list the apps on the device in the main screen, so you can choose the target app to configure.

All permissions are used only locally on this device; this app requests no internet permission.
If any prerequisite is not met, this app cannot work properly. Please enable this module in the framework and restart the device before trying again.

1. This app requests no internet permission and will not upload, collect, or share any data.
2. This app does not run a background service; it works only when you open it. Its interface process stops after you leave the main screen.
3. All configurations are saved in the local SharedPreferences; they are cleared when the app is uninstalled, with no leftover system traces.
4. Root access is used only when you actively perform \"save and apply configuration\", to chmod the configuration file and kill the target app process. It is never obtained silently in the background.
5. When the runtime environment is abnormal (module not activated, no root, etc.), this app does not perform any system-modifying operation and only prompts that the environment is abnormal.
6. This app is an open-source project (MIT License), so you can review the source code to verify its behavior.
Please record the original display density of the target app before making changes, so you can restore it at any time.

The complete usage flow is as follows:

1. On first launch, choose the injection method (the default \"Configuration injection\" is sufficient) and choose the app list retrieval mode (\"System interface\" or \"Root interface\").
2. The main screen lists the apps on the device. Tap any app to open its details page.
3. On the details page, set the DPI value and resolution (width x height) for that app; you can also override the injection method for that app separately.
4. Tap \"Save\" in the top right. The app will terminate the target app process, and the new configuration takes effect the next time you open that app.
5. If an injection method does not work for a particular app, switch to another method on that app's details page (Metrics injection, Resources management, UI injection, or Try all five at once).
6. Use the top right menu to show or hide system apps, and use the drawer to open Settings or About.
The injection method for a single app can be switched separately on its details page. If the configuration does not take effect, try another mode.
